observations.classification: Fixture hazard and bounded source observation

evidence.detail: payloadPath may be materialized before provenance admission
non-inline payload is stored as a blob
provenance guard follows payload materialization
receipt-bearing append also guards after payload preparation

observations.finding: An elevated producer refusal prevents the evidence row but can have payload filesystem effects. A no-new-row assertion is appropriate; an unconditional zero-effects claim is not.
observations.advice: For the bounded writeguard control, use an explicit harmless inline payload and initialize writer/session before the measured interval, or retain every actual payload effect. Keep refusal row snapshots and filesystem inventories separate.

observations.classification: Required assertion strengthening within the planned own-key case

evidence.detail: writer passes actual workspace own-key exclusions
refused own signatures become SELF_REPORTED/self_attested
reader exclusions require workspace argument
only declared ATTESTED plus valid binding reaches reader key verification

observations.finding: Cold-reading the writer-refused self_attested rows cannot exercise reader own-key exclusion because they already declare SELF_REPORTED.
observations.advice: Retain actual writer refusals, and add a clearly labelled local bound ATTESTED projection carrying a genuinely verified monitor/auditor signature and a real signed list naming that key. readerTrustFor(workspace) must downgrade it. Do not append or rewrite this projection, and do not claim it is a stored historical row.

evidence.detail: earliest copy replacement uses strictly smaller row.ts

observations.finding: Equal-timestamp copies are tied by input order. Reversing rows need not choose the same ID when both copy timestamps are equal.
observations.advice: Require distinct actual copy timestamps before the reversed-order assertion, or record a deliberately supplied owned duplicate timestamp greater than the genuine copy timestamp. The real ledger signature must cover that row; do not silently infer elapsed time.

contracts.name: Default loader and separately admitted root

evidence.detail: AMC_HOME override wins; fallback is os.homedir()/.config/amc
default list and roots file live beneath AMC home/trust
a present list without roots throws signature-invalid

contracts.detail: Use the owned process AMC_HOME/HOME for the actual no-argument loader in both initializer and cold reader. Empty/default missing list gives an empty pinned context, not a missing-root error. Root fingerprints are operator inputs, not trust-list-root purpose entries or values learned from the artifact.

contracts.name: Independent key fingerprint encoding

evidence.detail: sha256 of Node-canonical Ed25519 SPKI PEM UTF-8

contracts.detail: Record root and attester public PEM plus independent Node-canonical PEM SHA256 before list/attestation signatures. This is not the SHA256 of DER SPKI bytes. Carried root PEM must match an independently recorded root ID.

contracts.name: Signed list domain and attested digest bytes

evidence.detail: ASCII AMC_TRUST_LIST_V1 plus zero byte plus canonical JSON
signHexDigest signs 32 decoded hexadecimal digest bytes
recursive object-key sorting preserves array order

contracts.detail: Independent checks must use the same domain and encoding but independent crypto/canonical observer code. A signature over the 64-character digest text or list digest is a different message.

contracts.name: Entry admission at verifier time

evidence.detail: attestation admission does not pass claimedSignedAt
entry checks claimed time or context.asOf
list expiry uses now >= expiresAt

contracts.detail: These attestation fixtures check current loaded context.asOf. Entry validTo is exclusive; list expiry is separate. Keep explicitPins empty and both allow flags false. The loader does not reject future issuedAt; no signing-time authenticity or complete timestamp-policy claim follows.

contracts.name: Workspace own-key exclusions

evidence.detail: monitor/auditor current and authenticated public history IDs
history reader combines current key with authenticated history
own-key exclusion precedes trust-list admission

contracts.detail: Always pass workspace to the actual reader closure. Current-key fixtures do not prove every rotation/history scenario. Public-key history reads do not initialize signing keys.

contracts.name: Bundle binding and actor-label scope

evidence.detail: bundle digest and original ID/payload/agent/session/row time must bind
attestedBy and statement added after bundle digest
audit metadata lacks originalEventId

contracts.detail: The attester signs bundle entries, not attestedBy or statement. Root-signed subject text is list metadata, not authenticated human identity. Genuine bound review copy may read ATTESTED while the stamped audit reads SELF_REPORTED. The five-minute future skew is inclusive; the proposed +1ms refusal does not by itself test all boundaries.

contracts.name: Deduplication and window scope

evidence.detail: key is original event ID plus agent
signed entry time is tested inclusively against window

contracts.detail: Only rows classified ATTESTED with valid bound entries are deduplicated. Other rows pass through, including unrelated/self-reported controls. This helper check does not qualify full diagnostic/compliance window selection or regulatory eligibility.

contracts.name: Reader and metadata caches

evidence.detail: parsed metadata cached per row object
trust context and own IDs loaded once per reader closure
loader failure catches to null trust

contracts.detail: Use fresh objects for adversarial metadata variants and a fresh cold reader per signed-list variant. Record actual loader errors separately from tier downgrade. This is evaluation-local caching, not live revocation monitoring.

contracts.name: Read-only connection and measured effects

evidence.detail: readonly fileMustExist connection avoids writer pool, migrations, key initialization
SQLite coordination sidecars can still be created
readonly ledger close closes its direct database

contracts.detail: Close initializer writers and process before cold reads. Inventory files and raw rows before open and after close. WAL/SHM are possible real effects; do not claim nonexistent zero-effects. Payload reads use the actual reader and must preserve setup/read errors.
